body:
Features

This mod adds crafting recipes for:

Totem of Undying
Heavy Core
Enchanted Golden Apple (Notch Apple)
Elytra
Trident

All recipes are designed to feel expensive and endgame-friendly, so these legendary items still feel valuable while remaining obtainable in normal survival worlds.

Perfect For
Survival multiplayer servers
Hardcore worlds
Modpacks focused on progression
Players who prefer crafting over rare structure hunting
Balanced Gameplay

Craftable Treasures keeps the vanilla feel by requiring rare materials and challenging resources for every recipe. No overpowered shortcuts — just more ways to play.

Compatibility
Works with most vanilla-friendly modpacks
Lightweight and simple
Server-side friendly

Take control of your survival adventure and craft the items you thought were impossible.
